summary: Comparing the historical and current equipment lists shows significant turnover in the facility. Key instruments like the Transmission Electron Microscope, Scanning Electron Microscope, BET Surface Area Analyzer, and Single Crystal X-ray Diffractometer were removed. The High-Resolution Mass Spectrometer remains, while the X-ray Diffractometer appears to have been updated to a Multipurpose X-Ray Diffraction System. Several new instruments such as the Rheometer, NMR, and Fermentor have been added.
